text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Today, I'd like you all to join 
me 
in doing something 'pointless'!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ha-ha-ha! What's the matter, Grease? 
What's wrong? 
You haven't been able to stand up since 
you drank the 'Spirit Water' I gave you!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Guh... Y-You bastard...!! Why?! 
We were supposed to be comrades who fought 
side by side... Why?!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Uh-oh~ Looks like you're completely beat, 
huh? 
Gonna give up? Want to surrender and forge 
a Complete Contract with me?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Do I have no choice... but to 
fall...?! But that's the only... way 
forward—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lord Grease~. 
I adore you so deeply~. Ufufu~"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She's waiting for me in that town right 
now. 
Until I make it back there, I cannot 
fall!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, like shattering glass, the mental 
landscape fractures— 
(CRASH! CRACKLE, SMASHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Wh... H-How... How did you do that 
without a Complete Contract...! 
W-Well, whatever! Take him down, Dragon 
Breaker King!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, that's my line, right? *ahem*— 
"Will you be the one to teach me the taste 
of defeat?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right. Listen up, you foul 
fiends, and remember this well. 
I am the one who will eventually destroy 
you all... and purge this world's 
nightmares—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "The Imaginary Number Hunter."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I-I did it. I did itーーー! 
Oh yeahhhーーー! I pulled it offーー!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help! Thanks to 
you, I've completely memorized 
all the protagonist's lines from Volume 1 
of 'Grease: The Imaginary Number Hunter'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. That was wonderful~. I was 
following along on my tablet, 
and there wasn't a single mistake~.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... this series hasn't been adapted 
into an anime, so I figured I'd bring it 
to life myself! 
Reciting the lines and acting out the 
scenes was just so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I gained anything tangible 
from it— 
but wow, I feel such an incredible sense 
of satisfaction!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ I mean, we had a blast doing it too! 
Next time, let's not just do lines, let's 
get matching costumes too☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Isn't it about time for your 
turn, Ai? You must be sick of 
getting dragged around by now, right? 
Don't you have anything you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh... me? Something I want to do... 
Without any deep meaning... ......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! I want to go to the amusement park 
where Kyumaru is! Let's all go together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That's not quite it, you know? 
That's just a 'meaningful day off', isn't 
it? 
Going somewhere that's 'designed to 
entertain you' on a holiday is totally 
normal, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there something sillier that you 
still want to do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
S-Sillier...? Mmhmm...!  
...Special training so I can do over 
twenty sextuple jump-ropes... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not there yet. More! Go further!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Um... a-a staring contest! I want to get 
better at staring contests! Training for 
that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Is that the best you've got~?! You can do 
better than that!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if you say that...! I can't think 
of anything else! 
I won't be able to come up with anything 
more than that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Then how about you just do nothing at 
all?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(A part of me watching myself from above 
is screaming at the top of her lungs... 
'Just what in the world are you doing?!')

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I should be pushing myself through 
grueling training. I don't have 
the luxury to sit still. I know that, and 
yet—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, my favorite drugstore makeup brand 
just dropped new shades~! Time to hit 'Buy 
Now'~♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Lady Pandora~. It sounds familiar, 
but 
what exactly is 'drugstore makeup'~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you don't know, Bright-senpai? 
Petit-price stuff is basically cosmetics 
and stuff that's super cheap yet totally 
amazing quality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~, so that's what it is~. I 
completely assumed 
it was a famous confectionery from another 
country~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Like a macaron? 'Petit-price' 
definitely sounds like a bite-sized sweet 
treat. 
I should request the Tracen Academy school 
store to stock some~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(As I flop onto the futon, listening to 
everyone's voices... 
I wonder why... little by little, slowly 
but surely...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um! Speaking of which, I thought it 
sounded 
like the title of a 4-panel manga! 
'Petit-Priced!'.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like, there's a school club dedicated to 
studying makeup—the 'Fashion Club'— 
and the protagonists just hang around 
doing random things or nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's that, I totally wanna read 
it! Besides, wouldn't 'Petit-Pura' sound 
super cute written out? It sounds like a 
name you'd give a puppy~☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Surely that's a bit of a stretch...—Oh, 
wait, actually? If you gave it a nickname 
like 'Poo-chan', that might actually be 
cute. Yeah, it could be really adorable!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Somehow, this is starting to get fun. 
Everyone's voices feel so comforting. 
I find myself wanting to join in the 
conversation, too...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it gives that impression because 
the 'pa-pi-pu-pe-po' sounds are just so 
cute? Bright-san, could you try saying 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"??? All I have to do is say it~? 
——Pa-pi-pu-pe-po~♪ There you go~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: See? Adorable.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"……Aha. No, I don't think it's the sound 
at all—it's simply that Bright-san is 
naturally adorable."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"……By the way, confession time: when I was 
a kid, I honestly thought 'puchipura' 
meant 'tiny tempura.'"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'petit tempura'? Ahaha, sounds like 
a real shop! Next time, I'll ask the 
Student Council President to take me to a 
place that serves freshly fried 
'puchipura.'"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Having pointless conversations. Letting 
them ramble on. 
That sheer "meaninglessness" was somehow 
irresistibly comforting—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Could it be…… that this is it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Pandora-san, Kiseki-chan……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? What's up? 
Did you want some popcorn? Good, ain't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's tomorrow, could you keep me 
company for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *pant*, *pant*…… 
Well!? What's the time!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"……Yeah. Yeah…… Ai-chan—— 
That's right, yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It hasn't changed at all!
